dedupe_keys.name: tigerweb applications rest and wms map services

description: TIGERweb is the U.S. Census Bureau's web system for viewing and streaming TIGER geographic data without GIS software or downloads. It consists of web applications to view, search and identify features, and GeoServices REST and WMS map services that return Census boundaries and features by FIPS code or by latitude and longitude, grouped into services such as tracts and blocks, places and county subdivisions, legislative districts, school districts, PUMAs and ZCTAs, urban areas, hydrography, transportation and labels. Coverage: the United States, Puerto Rico and the Island Areas in several vintages: Current (boundaries in effect for the 2026 ACS, with legal boundaries reported to the 2026 Boundary and Annexation Survey through 1 March 2026, the 120th Congress districts and 2020 statistical areas including corrected urban areas), plus archived vintages such as the 2020 Census, the Economic Census and generalised ACS vintages back to 2012. Format and access: free web applications, ArcGIS REST MapServer endpoints (JSON, GeoJSON and images) and WMS; no key required; public domain. HTML data files list entities per vintage. Caveats: map services have request limits and are not intended for bulk national downloads, for which the TIGER/Line files are better; availability depends on the Census Bureau's servers. Simulation uses: on-the-fly lookup of the census unit containing an asset or hazard point, and streaming of boundaries and water or road layers into web dashboards and digital twins. Related records: the Census Geocoder, which feeds coordinates into TIGERweb, the Census Data API, TIGER/Line layers and Cartographic Boundary Files.
